b: i kept missing hackathons i actually wanted to participate in. finding them always meant going through unstop, devpost, devfolio and a bunch of other sites separately.
finally, i tried building something with antigravity & claude code. i asked claude design to create the design for the site, then used antigravity to build it and bring the listings together for me.
this is what it turned into. it's called brabble, and i'm honestly quite excited to share it here.
it brings the listings together so you can find something you're eligible for while registration is still open. you can also just tell it what kind of hackathon you're looking for.
5k+ people have signed up so far, which feels pretty wild considering this started with me wanting an easier way to find one.
i'd love for it to eventually become a place where we find interesting hackathons and go build stuff together.
